Bug_Details: Types contained in sorted collections must implement Comparable.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by attempting to sort an ArrayList of Person objects without implementing the Comparable interface in the Person class. This causes a compilation error due to the inability to compare Person objects.
